The '''Nova''' was an information holo-network existing during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Its holo-editor [[Fyrel Cannor]] spent some time on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] trying to uncover proof of [[House Ulgo]] crimes against [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] citizens.
